questions.q: Who created the Raj Comics hero Parmanu?
questions.why: Sanjay Gupta of Raj Comics created the atomic hero.
Vinay, a police inspector, wears the Parmanu suit.

questions.q: Which monster attacks the lab just before Parmanu's costume is revealed?
questions.why: Bufalo attacks Vinay and his uncle in the uncle's lab, and the uncle then reveals the costume.

questions.q: What colour is Parmanu's power suit?
questions.why: His bright yellow suit gives him flight, teleportation and shrinking.

questions.q: In which year did Parmanu first appear, in the comic Aag?
Parmanu's shrinking power is often compared to which Marvel hero?
questions.why: Observers liken his shrinking to Ant-Man and his origin to Batman.

questions.q: Who reveals the costume that gives the hero his superpowers?
options: His maternal uncle Prof. K. K. Verma
A rival inspector from the Delhi force
questions.why: Professor Kamal Kumar Verma rescued the boy and showed him the suit.

questions.q: Which ally converted Parmanu's belt controls to voice recognition?
questions.why: Probot upgraded the controls to voice recognition.

questions.q: In which Raj Comics series does Parmanu reportedly die?
questions.why: In Akhiri, he blasts himself into space to save Earth.

questions.q: Parmanu is a member of which team alongside Nagraj and Dhruva?
questions.why: Raj Comics lists Parmanu in Brahmand Rakshak, the Protectors of the Universe, with Nagraj and Dhruva.
